stem: Two cultivars were switched to the same photoperiod on the same date, but reproductive morphology develops at different rates. Which staging method is strongest?
choices: Force both into the same flower-week label because the calendar matches
Use actual reproductive morphology together with photoperiod and environmental records because genotype can alter developmental timing
rationale: Calendar time is supporting metadata, not biological stage by itself. Morphology and environmental context provide stronger evidence of reproductive development.
